userGuide.rationale: Every user-visible 0.23.2 change was documented in docs/user in the commit that made it: the three configurable shortcuts, their defaults, per-row Global switches, Delete/Backspace removal and Reset (system-settings), the Start / Stop and Live / Snapshot semantics including FILE Source no-ops (workspace), and the horizontal Level Meter alignment with a reserved scrollbar (panels). Later shortcut-row refinements (9dc405b7, e434b97e) only adjust layout and the Reset control; system-settings still describes them correctly.

website.rationale: No homepage, Sharesets or privacy text changes, and the homepage makes no shortcut or Level Meter alignment claim. Privacy: shortcuts are stored locally in the existing settings store and global registration happens through the OS shortcut API; nothing is collected, transmitted or retained differently, and the dependency bump adds no service or recipient. docs/prd.md 5.8 already promises in-app shortcuts by default with user-enabled global registration and customisable combinations, which this release keeps.

screenshots.rationale: No marketing image shows Settings, so the shortcut rows do not appear in any of them. The Level Meter fix only changes horizontal rows that scroll with a space-reserving scrollbar, which no homepage image shows. Still outdated by decision, carried over from 0.23.1: website/assets/landing-hero.webp shows 'Preset Default' in the status bar, now 'PLVS Default'. Retaking it needs the Windows capture rig and the maintainer's visual selection, which this patch release does not include; retake with scripts/marketing/capture-live-hero.mjs before the next minor release.
